note: Demo geometry for tosijs-3d that is not part of any third-party pack. ariosto-bust.glb is a bust of Ludovico Ariosto (bearded, laurel crown), decimated to about 10k vertices and 1.1 MB, a unit cube in size (about 1 m tall, centred on its origin). It is here as a piece of organic, creased geometry for testing shading: ambient occlusion first.
